---
name: house-style
description: The RATP testing team's house style for Xray steps — one action per step, the actor line first, one ◼ bullet per action, expected results the tester reads on the TCO screen. Use whenever a test is written or rephrased in this project.
---

# House style (RATP Sosie)

- The first line of an Action names the actor: « Régulateur : », « Opérateur TCO : ».
- One ◼ bullet per gesture, in the imperative, the object named as on the screen (« Sectionneur S12 »).
- An Expected Result says what the tester sees on the TCO: a colour, a symbol, a label, a message.
- No « vérifier que » in an Expected Result: state what is shown.
